_comment: Today in Disney History. Key = MM-DD. Add as many as you like; the script picks today's key, else falls back to a rotating evergreen entry. Keep blurb <= ~180 chars so it fits the card without crowding the castle art.

01-08.headline: Disneyland TV Special Airs
01-08.blurb: Walt introduced America to the still-under-construction Disneyland on ABC, six months before opening day.

05-27.headline: Disneyland Paris Opens
05-27.blurb: Disneyland Park officially opened its gates in Marne-la-Vallee, France, bringing the magic of Disney to Europe.

07-17.headline: Disneyland Opens
07-17.blurb: Walt Disney opened Disneyland in Anaheim, California, welcoming press and celebrities on a chaotic but historic first day.

08-05.headline: Enchanted Tiki Room Debuts
08-05.blurb: Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room opened at Disneyland, the first attraction to use Audio-Animatronics.

08-06.headline: Haunted Mansion Foolish Mortals
08-06.blurb: Disneyland's Haunted Mansion had welcomed its first eager ghosts just days earlier, an instant Anaheim classic.

10-01.headline: Walt Disney World Opens
10-01.blurb: The Magic Kingdom opened in Florida, the first piece of Walt Disney World Resort near Orlando.

10-16.headline: The Disney Company Is Founded
10-16.blurb: Walt and Roy Disney founded the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio, the humble start of the entire company.

12-05.headline: Walt Disney Is Born
12-05.blurb: Walter Elias Disney was born in Chicago, Illinois, the visionary who would reshape animation and theme parks.
